scope: Replace all 13 native select controls across settings, personas, studio and the Live2D library with the shared Select component.

checks: Panel opens above a trigger near the viewport bottom, outside the modal scroll clipping area.
Arrow keys and Enter update the selected value and restore trigger focus.
Home and End navigate to the first and last options.
Escape closes the list while keeping the settings dialog open.
A temporary unsaved connection with nine models supports grouped search and long labels.
An unmatched query shows the empty result state.
Tab from the search input closes the list and focuses the next form control.
At 390px width, the panel stays inside the viewport and a long model name wraps without horizontal overflow. The viewport override was reset.

isolatedComponentFixture.purpose: Exercise loading and error states without using a real account or changing account settings.
checks: Tab reaches the retry button, and Enter starts loading rather than selecting an option.
Retry keeps the list open, moves focus to search, and immediately shows a loading skeleton.
A completed retry replaces the skeleton with options.
Keyboard navigation skips a disabled option.

limits: The loading and retry fixture uses simulated options; this check does not establish real Sakta account availability.
